preview.subtitle: Internal six-model Tier 2 release from one comparable dev-harness case set. Read overall, trusted, and provisional pass rates together.

notes: Headline charts and claims are derived strictly from the comparable headline set.
Benchmark-validity gates remain visible as failure-mode signals, but this release treats them as informational after apples-to-apples retries.

policyDecisions.rationale: After apples-to-apples all-non-pass retries, persistent timeout/no-reply/stuck-loop gates are treated as workload-specific failure modes rather than release-disqualifying contamination for this dev-harness Tier 2 release.

insights.claim: DeepSeek V4 Pro leads the current comparable headline set on overall pass rate.
Kimi K2.6 is the lowest-cost comparable run, but DeepSeek V4 Pro still leads this release on overall task completion.
GPT-5.5 reaches a first user-visible reply faster than the rest of the comparable set, but lower latency does not automatically mean higher completion.
Memory behavior is the task family where the current models separate most clearly in this release.
